attachments.name: AUTOMATED REPAIRS
attachments.bonusInstruction: During an attack, the first wounded figure in this group that can spend 1 {B} spends it to recover 2 {H} before resolving other surge abilities. If no wounded figure does so, at the end of this activation the most-wounded figure recovers 1 {H}.

attachments.name: IMPERIAL OPERATIVE
attachments.bonusInstruction: At the start of this activation, this figure becomes <color="red">Focused</color>.
